_note: What you see: The app settings of learniq with renewing the signing key and the processing register with review dates.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: De app-instellingen van learniq met het vernieuwen van de ondertekensleutel, de koppeling van kenmerken uit de schoolinlog aan profielvelden en rollen (met een proefinlog en de vergrendelde velden), en het verwerkingsregister per schema met status en herzieningsdata.
Het register waarin learniq zijn gegeven: The register in which learniq keeps its data.
Het toezicht op AI-functies met een hoog: Oversight of high-risk AI functions under the EU AI Act runs centrally through hermiq. The AI functions of learniq are registered there and the data protection officer confirms them there.
Learniq maakt geen profiel van hoe een l: Learniq does not profile how a pupil prefers to learn. Research finds no gain in lessons that match such a profile (NRO Kennisrotonde, Differentiatie in de klas). Differentiate by level, goal, time and material. Record support needs in the group plan or the learning plan.
Learniq ondertekent uitgegeven certifica: Learniq signs issued certificates with an RS256 key pair. The key pair is stored encrypted in the Nextcloud key store.
The signing key has been renewed.
Een nieuwe sleutel ondertekent alleen ce: A new key only signs certificates issued from now on. Certificates issued earlier stay valid and can still be verified.
Wie via Entree Federatie, SURFconext of: Whoever signs in through Entree Federatie, SURFconext or eduID gets their profile filled from what the school sends along. The sign-in itself runs through Nextcloud (user_saml or user_oidc); learniq only maps the attributes to profile fields.
Plak wat de school bij een inlog meestuu: Paste what the school sends along with a sign-in and see which fields learniq fills. Nothing is saved.
ECK iD, SchoolID, voornaam, achternaam e: The school fills ECK iD, SchoolID, first name, last name and the role from a mapping again at every sign-in. The user and the administrator do not change them in learniq; an archived mapping leaves the field as it was.
Learniq legt zijn verwerkingen van perso: Learniq records its processing of personal data in the processing register of OpenRegister. Only administrators and the data protection officer see it.
De school is verwerkingsverantwoordelijk: The school is the controller. Set that once in OpenRegister and it appears on every export and every accountability report.
Verantwoordelijke en verantwoording open: Open controller and accountability in OpenRegister
Learniq meldt tien verwerkingen aan. Ze: Learniq registers ten processing activities. They arrive as drafts in OpenRegister; the privacy officer checks them, adjusts them and sets them active there.
Het leerlingdossier bijhouden, met versl: Keep the pupil file, with encrypted BSN, ECK iD and SchoolID, to provide education and report as required by law.
Aanwezigheid registreren en verzuim meld: Record attendance and report absenteeism to the attendance officer and DUO.
Toetsen afnemen en cijfers en eindcijfer: Administer tests and record grades and final grades.
aangemeld door learniq, nog te beoordele: registered by learniq, still to be assessed
Afgeronde verplichte training en onderte: Record completed mandatory training and signed statements as legal proof.
Controleerbare certificaten uitgeven, co: Issue, verify and revoke verifiable certificates.
Leerling- en resultaatgegevens uitwissel: Exchange pupil and result data with DUO, OSO, the municipality and HR systems.
Elk schema met persoonsgegevens draagt z: Every schema with personal data carries its own processing activity: code, purpose, legal basis, categories of data and retention period. If a schema lacks its processing activity, the register check fails and names the schema. New processing activities come in as drafts, with a review date as soon as the privacy officer sets them active.
Het log van elke inzage en het overzicht: OpenRegister makes the log of every access and the overview per data subject, limited to the register of learniq.
Het log per inzage en het overzicht per: The log per access and the overview per data subject exist now. The export of the whole register as a file is coming in OpenRegister; until then the register sits as verwerkingsregister.csv in the audit pack.
Leg het privacyconvenant en de privacybi: Record the privacy covenant and the privacy leaflet, and follow requests for correction or deletion.
De verwerkersovereenkomst van het Privac: The processor agreement of the Privacy Covenant has been signed
